description: Living state for all TOURney platform axes. One entry per axis. Updated by every tourney-* skill. Agents read this for context (50 tokens) instead of parsing HTML artifacts.

architecture.summary: Clean init layer, tournament_admins canonical, 11 versioned migrations. Settings store un-typed.

feature-depth.summary: 3 structures, 12 scoring formats, realtime, HIO. No score admin-edit UI, no tournament series.

ux.summary: Consistent dark-gold system, mobile nav. No loading skeletons, empty states partial, a11y unaudited.

security.summary: send-push JWT live, install-email webhook gate deployed. Open: CSP unsafe-inline, RLS permissive players/scores/push_subscriptions.

business.summary: Stripe fully wired in code. BLOCKED: LLC not formed, no live keys, no ToS/Privacy.

deployment.summary: Vercel static, full security headers, SW v17. No CI/CD, no staging, no monitoring.

performance.summary: SW cache-first, realtime scorecard, DB indexes. No loading skeletons, no perf monitoring.

data-model.summary: 11 migrations clean. Settings un-typed, player_accounts anon read still open.

marketing.summary: Premium brand, clear pricing, live demo. No OG tags, no social proof, PWA differentiator buried.

onboarding.summary: Invite gate kills cold traffic. Signup requires pre-existing RSVP. PWA install orphaned.

finance.summary: Stripe wiring B+. Zero revenue — LLC not formed, no live keys, reg_open=false, no ToS.
